events.name: Last Soul Ultra
events.gpxStatus: 2027 World Series confirmed with three qualifiers and a qualification-only Germany final. The organizer confirms a 6.706 km backyard loop, but no public downloadable GPX. Do not represent this as a single event with a fixed German venue/date.
events.followUp: Wait for organizer to publish venue/loop GPX for each qualifier and Germany final; retain any prior German course as a historical separate version.

verified2027Edition.note: 2027 is not one single Last Soul Ultra race in Germany; organizer announces three qualifiers and a Germany final. Venues for later qualifiers/final are not yet announced.

events.followUp: Request official GPX for both distances from organizer; keep third-party route only as a separately sourced candidate until confirmed.

verified2027Edition.note: 2027 date and additional short format confirmed by current event listings; organizer must be treated as final authority for exact distance and GPX.
